d: The border dispute between India and China has come into focus again after Arunachal Pradesh Congress president Bosiram Siram claimed that Chinese troops had moved 40–50 km inside Indian territory in the Upper Subansiri district. Siram said local residents in border areas shared concerns about Chinese military activity and restrictions on their movement. However, Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu and Union Minister Kiren Rijiju have rejected claims of Chinese intrusion, while the Indian Army has also dismissed similar allegations in the past.
